prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) tall date palm tree; 2) short palm tree; 3) round cactus with flowers; 4) desert market stall with a striped cloth canopy and spice sacks; 5) stack of clay water jars; 6) rolled carpets on a rack; 7) sandstone obelisk with glyphs; 8) broken sandstone pillar; 9) tomb urn with a lid; 10) animal skull and bones in sand; 11) dry thorn bush; 12) stone oasis well (dry); 13) copper brazier on a tripod (unlit); 14) wooden cart with barrels; 15) small sand dune mound.
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a sprite sheet IMAGE, landscape canvas, exactly fifteen distinct isolated game props in a 3 COLUMNS x 5 ROWS grid, reading left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Generous blank gutters and margin, each sprite entirely contained in its cell, no overlap or clipping. TRANSPARENT alpha background, no ground or bases added unless part of object, no drop shadows, no labels, numbers, words, borders or gridlines. Classic three-quarter TOP-DOWN JRPG perspective, showing top surface and front face of props, upright objects' bases at bottom. Exact grid contents: ROW 1: (1) tall date palm tree with trunk and fronds, (2) short palm tree, (3) round flowering cactus. ROW 2: (4) desert market stall, striped cloth canopy and spice sacks, (5) stack of clay water jars, (6) rolled carpets on rack. ROW 3: (7) sandstone obelisk with glyphs, (8) broken sandstone pillar, (9) lidded tomb urn. ROW 4: (10) animal skull and bones with a little sand integrated into sprite, (11) dry thorn bush, (12) dry stone oasis well. ROW 5: (13) UNLIT copper brazier on tripod, (14) wooden cart holding barrels, (15) small mound of sand dune. Premium modern hi-bit 2D HD pixel art RPG asset style: deliberate uniformly sized crisp SQUARE pixels (each visible art pixel ~6-8 final-image pixels), solid pixel clusters of 3-10 art pixels, sharp hard edges, no antialiasing, no smoothing, no blur, no noise, no dithering, no checkerboards, no photos. Trees significantly taller (~60-70 art pixels) than smaller props (~16-24 art pixels). Rich earthy palette, 4-6 flat shades per material with hue shifted ramps, warm yellow highlights and saturated purple-red shadows; clean base colors, soft even neutral upper-left illumination. NO glow, no flames, no night treatment, no dramatic or cast shadows, no vignette. Each prop recognizable and separate; polished coherent videogame sprites.
